nodes.name: Requirements, Scope & Threat Boundary
acceptance_criteria: Functional scope and explicit non-goals documented
Device/OS version targets for Android, macOS, and VPS defined
VPS data-retention policy stated in testable terms
tests: Requirements doc reviewed against all brief areas
Sign-off recorded before ARCH-1 starts

nodes.name: High-Level System Architecture
acceptance_criteria: Component and data-flow diagrams cover Android, VPS, Mac
Every REQ-1 requirement traces to a component
Technology stack per platform decided and justified
tests: Architecture reviewed against REQ-1 checklist
Diagram peer-reviewed for gaps

nodes.name: Threat Model & Abuse-Case Analysis
acceptance_criteria: Threats covering VPS compromise, device loss, replay/MITM, unauthorized camera use documented
Non-consensual-use abuse case analyzed with resulting design constraints
Every threat has a mitigation or accepted-risk note
tests: Threat list cross-checked against every later security-relevant node
Abuse-case constraints traced into CAM-1 and FILE-5 specs

nodes.name: Android Project Foundation
acceptance_criteria: Project builds via CI
Lint/static analysis configured
Module structure supports later features
tests: `./gradlew build` succeeds in CI
Empty app launches on emulator

nodes.name: Transport & Session Protocol Design
acceptance_criteria: Transport/encryption scheme defined (E2E, VPS relays ciphertext only)
Session-establishment sequence diagrammed
Key-exchange approach specified
tests: Protocol spec self-reviewed against ARCH-4 threats
Handshake sequence diagram completed

nodes.name: Mac Client Project Foundation
acceptance_criteria: Project builds via CI
Skeleton CLI executable runs
tests: Build succeeds in CI
Skeleton binary prints version/help

nodes.name: VPS Base Infrastructure & Deployment Skeleton
acceptance_criteria: Reproducible deployment (IaC/script) provisions a hardened base host
Skeleton service reachable over TLS
tests: Re-running deployment script yields an identical environment
Port scan shows only intended ports open

nodes.name: Android Device Identity Provisioning
acceptance_criteria: Stable device ID tied to a Keystore-backed keypair generated on first launch
ID persists across restarts; reinstall yields a new identity
tests: Unit test: identity persists after process restart
Unit test: reinstall produces new identity

nodes.name: Android Core Network Transport Layer
acceptance_criteria: TLS/mTLS (per ARCH-2) connection established to VPS
Connect/disconnect/error events handled cleanly
tests: Simulated connect success/TLS-failure/unreachable-server tests pass
State-transition unit tests pass

nodes.name: Application Message Schema & API Contract
acceptance_criteria: Versioned schema for auth, file ops, camera ops, status, errors
Backward-compatible versioning strategy defined
tests: Schema validated with a linter
Example messages round-trip in a test script

nodes.name: Test Infrastructure & CI Pipeline
acceptance_criteria: CI runs unit tests for all three components on every change
Regression-suite hook defined for the Node Completion Protocol
tests: CI green on a trivial change to each component
CI correctly fails on an intentionally broken test

nodes.name: VPS Platform Security Hardening
acceptance_criteria: Firewall, strong TLS config, key-only SSH, secrets kept out of source control
Basic rate limiting/brute-force protection active
tests: External TLS scan meets defined bar
Automated secret-scan finds nothing
Brute-force simulation triggers rate limiting

nodes.name: VPS Logging & Monitoring
acceptance_criteria: Structured logs for auth/connection/error events
File contents, camera frames, and message payloads never logged
Basic alerting on repeated auth failures
tests: Log audit finds no payload data under normal and error conditions
Simulated repeated-failure triggers an alert

nodes.name: Android Cryptographic Key Management
acceptance_criteria: Keys generated/stored in Android Keystore, hardware-backed where available
Keys never exportable in plaintext
Signing operation available for the auth handshake
tests: Unit test confirms non-exportability
Instrumented test: key survives app update

nodes.name: Android Background Execution & Foreground Service
acceptance_criteria: Connection maintained via a compliant foreground service with a persistent, user-visible notification
Correct foreground-service-type declared per current Android rules
No use of undocumented APIs to evade Doze/App Standby
tests: Instrumented test: notification visible for entire service lifetime
Manual test: service survives normal Doze cycling on a real device

nodes.name: VPS Device Authentication & Identity Registry
acceptance_criteria: Authorized-device registry verifies signatures/certs on connect
Unregistered devices rejected
Revocation takes effect immediately for new connections
tests: Integration test: registered device authenticates
Integration test: unregistered device rejected
Integration test: revoked device rejected post-revocation

nodes.name: Android Secure Local Storage
acceptance_criteria: Tokens/config stored via EncryptedSharedPreferences or equivalent
No secrets in plaintext logs or files
tests: Static scan finds no plaintext secret storage
Instrumented test: data unreadable outside app sandbox

nodes.name: Android Boot-Persistence & Reboot Recovery
acceptance_criteria: Service resumes after reboot per RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED and current deferred-start rules, without manual app reopen where the OS permits
Degrades gracefully (prompts user) if OEM auto-start restrictions block it
tests: Manual reboot test on 2+ real devices/OEMs
Verifies no crash if boot-complete permission is later revoked

nodes.name: Mac Authentication & Identity
acceptance_criteria: Mac generates/stores a Keychain-backed identity keypair
Completes auth handshake against VPS-2
tests: Integration test: Mac authenticates against staging VPS
Credential wipe/re-pair flow tested

nodes.name: VPS Session Coordination & Signaling
acceptance_criteria: Tracks connected authorized devices and pairs Android/Mac sessions
Exposes presence/status
tests: Integration test with two simulated clients confirms correct pairing
No cross-pairing across unrelated device pairs

nodes.name: Android Authentication Handshake
acceptance_criteria: Device completes handshake against a live VPS-2 instance
Bad credentials and expired tokens are rejected
tests: Integration test: successful auth against staging VPS
Integration test: wrong-key and expired-token rejection

nodes.name: Camera Permission & Explicit Activation Authorization Flow
acceptance_criteria: Camera access requires OS runtime permission plus a separate in-app opt-in toggle, defaulting OFF
Remote activation requests are never auto-approved
tests: Instrumented test: camera cannot activate remotely while the app-level toggle is OFF
Fresh-install test confirms toggle defaults OFF

nodes.name: Android Storage Access Layer
acceptance_criteria: Requests only minimum storage permissions via SAF/MediaStore/scoped storage
Handles permission denial gracefully
No access outside granted scope
tests: Instrumented tests for granted and denied permission paths

nodes.name: Mac Connection Manager
acceptance_criteria: Manages connect/disconnect/reconnect lifecycle
Exposes current status to CLI/future GUI
tests: Integration test: simulated disconnect drives correct status transitions and reconnect attempts

nodes.name: VPS Relay Data Path
acceptance_criteria: Forwards encrypted messages between paired sessions without decrypting them
Enforces per-connection size/rate limits
No payload retained after relay
tests: Integration test: byte-for-byte relay integrity both directions
Audit confirms no payload persists in VPS memory/disk after relay

nodes.name: VPS Session Resumption & Reconnection Handling
acceptance_criteria: Session resumes after brief disconnect without full re-auth, within a defined token-validity window
tests: Integration test: disconnect N seconds, reconnect, session resumes with minimal Mac-side interruption

nodes.name: Android Reconnection & Network-Change Handling
acceptance_criteria: Detects connectivity loss and Wi-Fi/cellular handoff
Reconnects with exponential backoff and jitter
Resumes session without full re-auth where the protocol allows
tests: Airplane-mode toggle test
Wi-Fi-to-cellular handoff test
VPS-restart reconnection test

nodes.name: Android Camera Capture Module
acceptance_criteria: Camera activates only within a foreground service carrying the OS-mandated camera-in-use indicator
Camera deactivates immediately on session end/timeout
tests: Instrumented test: OS camera-in-use indicator present for entire capture duration
Auto-deactivation test after session end/timeout

nodes.name: First End-to-End Encrypted Connection
acceptance_criteria: Real Android device, real Mac, and staging VPS authenticate and exchange a test message end-to-end
VPS relay confirmed never to see plaintext
tests: Scripted E2E ping test Mac to Android and Android to Mac
Instrumentation confirms ciphertext-only relay

nodes.name: Mac CLI Command Framework
acceptance_criteria: Extensible CLI with help text and consistent argument parsing
Scriptable, correct exit codes
tests: Smoke test for each defined command
Non-zero exit code confirmed on failure paths

nodes.name: VPS Direct-Connection Optimization (Optional)
acceptance_criteria: Direct path used when both clients can establish one, reducing relay load
Automatic, seamless fallback to VPS-4 relay on failure
tests: Integration test on NAT-friendly network confirms direct path used
Integration test on restrictive NAT confirms seamless relay fallback

nodes.name: Camera Frame Streaming Protocol & Transport
acceptance_criteria: Frames encoded and streamed through the relay at an acceptable rate/latency for a preview use case
tests: Integration test measures end-to-end latency/frame rate under defined network conditions
Stream-stop test after camera deactivation

nodes.name: Remote File Listing
acceptance_criteria: Mac CLI requests and displays an Android directory listing via the relay
tests: Integration test: listing a known test directory matches exactly on the Mac side

nodes.name: Device Discovery & Status Reporting
acceptance_criteria: Mac CLI shows accurate online/offline status for the authorized Android device
tests: Integration test: toggling Android connectivity updates Mac status within a defined latency bound

nodes.name: End-to-End Connection Recovery
acceptance_criteria: System recovers automatically from Android network loss, VPS restart, and Mac network loss without manual re-pairing
tests: Three scripted failure-injection scenarios each verified to recover within defined bounds

nodes.name: Mac Camera Viewer Client
acceptance_criteria: Viewer displays incoming frames when active and a clear inactive state otherwise
tests: Manual test: live frames shown during an authorized session; inactive state shown otherwise

nodes.name: Secure File Download
acceptance_criteria: Files download through the relay with checksum verification
Interrupted large-file transfers resume or fail cleanly
tests: Small- and large-file (>100MB) download with checksum match
Mid-transfer interruption test

nodes.name: Secure File Upload
acceptance_criteria: Files upload through the relay with checksum verification
Android-side storage permission scope enforced
tests: Mirror of FILE-3 tests in the upload direction
Write-outside-permitted-directory attempt is rejected

nodes.name: Scoped Remote Action System
acceptance_criteria: Fixed, build-time allowlist of remote actions only, no arbitrary command or shell execution exists anywhere
Each action independently permission-gated and user-visible on the Android side
tests: Security test: no code path accepts an arbitrary command string
Each allowlisted action verified to produce its user-visible effect

nodes.name: Cross-Component Security Hardening Pass
acceptance_criteria: Cert/key pinning applied where relevant
Replay-attack protection (nonces/timestamps) in place
Dependency scan clean of high/critical issues
tests: Replay-attack simulation rejected
Malformed/fuzzed message inputs handled without crash
Dependency vulnerability scan run with no unresolved high/critical findings

nodes.name: Cross-Component Integration Test Suite
acceptance_criteria: Scripted suite exercises auth, discovery, files, remote actions, and camera against staging VPS + real/emulated clients
tests: Full suite passes twice consecutively (flakiness check)
Suite fails clearly on an intentionally introduced regression

nodes.name: Security Validation & Penetration Testing
acceptance_criteria: Self-pentest against the ARCH-4 threat model completed
Camera/file/remote-action authorization gates verified un-bypassable via raw protocol manipulation
tests: Attempted camera activation, file access, and remote action via crafted raw messages all rejected; results documented

nodes.name: Network Failure & Chaos Testing
acceptance_criteria: Packet loss, latency injection, VPS restart, and client network loss all produce defined, safe behavior
tests: Each chaos scenario scripted/executed with pass/fail recorded against INT-3 recovery-time bounds

nodes.name: Android Compatibility Matrix Testing
acceptance_criteria: Core flows verified across 3+ real devices spanning 2+ OEMs and 2+ supported Android versions
tests: Matrix execution log with pass/fail per device/OS combination for each core flow

nodes.name: Consolidated Documentation & Setup Guide
acceptance_criteria: Setup guide, architecture summary, threat-model summary, troubleshooting guide, and privacy/consent statement all present
tests: Dogfood test: following only the docs produces a working paired setup

nodes.name: VPS Production Deployment
acceptance_criteria: Production VPS deployed via the same reproducible process as VPS-1, with monitoring active
Documented rollback procedure
tests: Fresh deployment succeeds from a clean environment
Rollback procedure executed successfully in a drill

nodes.name: Android Release Build & Signing
acceptance_criteria: Signed release APK/AAB produced via a repeatable process
Obfuscation/minification applied without breaking functionality
tests: Signed build installs and passes a smoke-test subset of TEST-2 on a real device

nodes.name: Mac Release Build & Packaging
acceptance_criteria: Signed (and notarized, if distributed outside a controlled environment) build produced via a repeatable process
tests: Fresh install from the packaged build passes a smoke-test subset of TEST-2

nodes.name: Final Acceptance Testing & Release Readiness
acceptance_criteria: All Level-1 subsystems complete
TEST-2/3/4 green and SEC-2 findings resolved
Fresh-environment end-to-end dry run succeeds
tests: Full fresh-environment dry run (new phone + new Mac + production VPS) executed and recorded
